newsitem.title: USA: Urban Shopping Centers wins Atlanta pact.
newsitem.headline: Urban Shopping Centers wins Atlanta pact.

text.p: Urban Shopping Centers Inc said Wednesday it will assume leasing, marketing and property management responsibilities for the Underground Atlanta shopping complex in conjunction with the Atlanta development firm Huntley & Associates.
The complex includes more than 100 specialty shops, nightclubs and restaurants in the heart of downtown Atlanta.
The company said the contract, worth an undisclosed amount, was awarded by Underground Festival Inc, which owns the commercial facilities at Underground Atlanta.
Urban Shopping Centers is a real estate investment trust.
Its shares were trading off 1/8 Wednesday at 31.
